summary: Configured node1 to record sudo commands in /var/log/sudo-commands.log with timestamp, invoking user, target user, working directory, and command. Disabled sudo syslog emission so command entries stay out of /var/log/messages and /var/log/secure. Configuration and logging persisted across reboot.
actions_performed: Set sudo logfile to /var/log/sudo-commands.log, disabled syslog output, and enabled four-digit years.
Verified pre- and post-restart commands were logged only in the dedicated root-owned mode-0600 file.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed and logging recovered.

evidence.requirement: Record every sudo command with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log, excluding entries from general system logs
evidence.summary: Shows valid sudoers settings, dedicated logfile metadata, timestamped entries identifying invoking user antrieb and target USER=root, and probe markers absent from /var/log/messages and /var/log/secure.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID 5a5e9b96-bf0e-4600-89d9-f83851199f03; rsyslog was active, sudoers parsed successfully, pre-restart data remained, and a new post-restart sudo command was logged exclusively in the dedicated file.
